**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.WebAppData`

## Constructor

## Documentation

Contains data sent from a [Web App](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps) to the bot.

### Parameters

- **`data`** (`str`)
  The data.

- **`button_text`** (`str`)
  Text of the *web_app* keyboard button, from which the Web App was opened.
